title: Machine-written Items record the run that wrote them
description: All 1,388 Machines on Machines Items had empty createdBy and source, so cleanup had to select on type, stage and status. Every machine write records its run id. Undoing a run is one reversible step. Ties into who-wrote-what on the Chatticus channel record. Holds knowledge-run rollouts with the preview story. Gherkin specs.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented on feature/PPY-5b5a5d-run-id-on-machine-items, PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/1058. Item has no createdBy or source column, so the run is recorded in Item.metadata.machineWrite (runId, createdByRunId, writer, at): no schema change. Covers the wiki sync (--run-id) and the idea pipeline (knowledge-<publication>-<execution>). New: papyrus knowledge run undo|restore --run-id (dry run unless --apply; retired stage; never deletes). Tests: test_machine_writes.py (14), features_backend/knowledge-run-undo.feature (10 scenarios), knowledge_cloud tests. Not deployed: needs a release and a rebuilt knowledge-run image.
